dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: This kitchen looks like a convenient place for not only cooking, but also making decoctions. Thank you for inviting me here.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Hmm... This small stove will do nicely, and I already have all the other equipment with me.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It's a great relief knowing I won't have to keep my patients waiting. Thank you.
